purpose: Fresh internal end-to-end ranking validation of pure Qwen3 reranking on new multilingual queries.

freshness_rules: No exact query may appear in benchmark/queries.json.
No exact query may appear in benchmark/qwen3/validation/qwen3-reranker-v1-holdout.preregistered.json.
These five semantic families were not used in the 50-query ranking development benchmark or the earlier 20-query Qwen classifier holdout.

candidate_ranking_policy.B: sort the exact same frozen Top-20 pool by qwen_raw_score descending

human_audit.primary_metric: exact paired delta P@10 (B minus A)
human_audit.sample_rule: Blindly adjudicate every query-document pair in the symmetric difference between A and B Top 10.

relevance_scale.1: Relacionado de forma tangencial o insuficiente para la necesidad completa.
relevance_scale.3: Altamente relevante o central para la consulta.

human_audit.absolute_p10_policy: Do not claim absolute human P@10 unless shared Top-10 slots are also adjudicated; the symmetric-difference audit identifies paired delta P@10 exactly.

ordering_constraints: Freeze this preregistration and exact fresh queries before retrieval.
Freeze production Top-20 retrieval before constructing Qwen model input.
Freeze clean model-input dataset before Qwen inference.
Freeze Qwen raw scores before constructing A/B rankings.
Freeze deterministic A/B rankings before constructing the blind human audit.
Freeze all human judgments before joining them back to A/B provenance.
Do not tune score blending, thresholds, query formulation, retrieval policy, or Qwen instruction using holdout labels.

decision_scope.note: A positive holdout result can support a later production integration decision, but this preregistration itself does not change production ranking code.
